SOURCE AND VERIFICATION

A score, not a guess.

The initial grid uses the opening three bars of Leiki Ueda’s published arrangement of Mia & Sebastian’s Theme. Pitches and written durations were read visually from page 1. Its printed tempo is 88 BPM in 3/4. Three bars last approximately 6.14 seconds at a constant tempo.

Recording timing is unverified. No soundtrack recording or MIDI comparison has been performed. Rubato, piano pedal, articulation and the left-hand accompaniment are omitted. This does not claim to reproduce the soundtrack performance.

Bar 1: C#4 F#4 G#4 A4 G#4 F#4, all eighth notes. Bar 2: D4, dotted half note. Bar 3: D4 F#4 G#4 A4 G#4 F#4, all eighth notes. Middle C is C4.

Drawing-site inspection

The current web app was inspected on 16 October 2026. Its full Instrument controls require a normal unlock. The desktop canvas is 16 quarter-note beats; the narrow phone canvas is 8. The guide’s full-canvas mapping uses the app’s audible pitch-row centers and occupied quantize cells.

Every ink stroke is musical data. Extra curves can add/change notes. A photo background is silent but fills the whole page, so it needs calibration to align with the canvas. The studio’s PMT background export supplies editable viewport and canvas measurements.

Keeping your work

The studio code and initial study are saved in a versioned cloud repository. Browser edits and revision history save on your device. Export JSON or copy a project link to move them to another device; there is no automatic cloud sync.
